content_units: Biggest concern:   Chemistry (73)  , followed by   Math (78)   and   Economics (80)  .
The subject that needs the most attention before finals is   Chemistry   because it has the lowest grade. Math is next, since it is also below 80 and often benefits from steady practice.
Subject   Current Grade   Priority   Suggested Hours
-   Chemistry  : lowest score, so this is the clearest opportunity to raise your overall results.
-   Math  : needs reinforcement and usually improves with repeated problem-solving.
-   Economics  : moderate attention to prevent it from slipping.
-   Biology  : light review to keep it solid.
-   Literature   and   History  : maintenance only; they do not need heavy time this week.
- Focus your first 2 study sessions on   Chemistry   topics you lose the most marks on.
- Use   Math   time mostly for practice problems, not rereading notes.
- Spend the final   1.5 hours   on quick review and recall for your stronger subjects.
This allocation assumes your goal is to   improve the weakest grades first while still keeping stronger subjects fresh  .
